text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — we've been seeing flaky thermal "realtime probe" resets on a subset of racks in the Saturn pool. Small but consistent throttles, causing ~2-3% capacity variance across the cohort. Thinking a short maintenance sprint to run targeted firmware + soft reboots.
Priya: can you share affected rack ids and a proposed window? we should avoid peak apac hours if possible.
Alex: affected: saturn-rack-12, -13, -17, -21 (cohort tag = saturn-therm-2025). Proposal: Tue Feb 18 18:00-20:00 UTC, rolling by rack, 10m cordon/drain + 20m reboot + 15m backfill/warmup per rack.
Sam: 10m cordon seems tight for KV heavy jobs. can we extend drain to 15m? also we need to pin a canary node first.
Jess: agree on canary. recommend canary on rack-12 during off-peak; we'll run perf smoke + kv cache seed.
Alex: ok extend drain to 15m — timeline updated. Canaries: rack-12 then rack-17. full run: ~3 racks at a time but stagger to keep egress headroom.
Luis: capacity question — with 3 racks rotating will we hit any customer QPS SLOs? quick math: saturn has 48 GPUs per rack, losing 3 racks = 144 GPUs. Current spare pool is ~220 GPUs; but spot/backfill headroom is variable.
Priya: ops: please post a short customer-facing blurb after we lock window. product needs heads-up if latency SLOs could be impacted.
Sam: on the tech side I'll own the KV-cache reseed script and a warmup task. sample check command I'll run on the canary after it's back:
```
kubectl get pods -l app=generator -o wide --namespace=prod-saturn
curl -sS http://monitoring.internal/health?saturn_canary=1 | jq .p90_latency
```
Jess: i'll validate model routing fallback and pin a fallback model on dedicated pool just in case.
ops-bot: Change scheduled: CHG-2025-1478 — Maintenance window Tue 2025-02-18 18:00-20:00 UTC. Owner: Alex. Affected tags: saturn-therm-2025. Backout: abort reboots and reintroduce nodes.
Alex: quick risk note — some racks intermittently report NIC flaps when thermal probe resets. if we see net flaps during canary, abort and escalate to hw team.
Luis: cost check — rolling reboots + backfill will spike ephemeral cost for ~2 hours; estimate ~$3.2k on reserved vs spot delta. flagging finance for FYI.
Priya: can someone draft a 2-line internal comm and a one-liner for status page? i can send to legal for compliance signoff if needed.
Sam: i'll prepare the runbook snippet for post-reboot validation (latency checks, unit tests, KV seed count) and paste in #runbooks before the window.
Jess: tagging @oncall for Tuesday shift rounds so they can watch the canary metrics. also i'll open a quick dashboard with P90, error-rate, and QoS by tenant.
Alex: thanks — final checklist: canary plan (Sam/Jess), drain timing (15m), warmup script (Sam), fallback model pinned (Jess), comms (Priya), ops-bot change noted. meet 1h before window for preflight.
Priya: ack. i'll schedule preflight at 17:00 UTC and drop calendar invites.
ops-bot: Reminder: preflight meeting created: MEET-4512 Tue 2025-02-18 17:00 UTC.
Alex: perfect. will post live updates in this thread during maintenance. :rocket:
